metadata.description: Canonical library of reusable Claude Code skills, organized as plugins by install unit.

plugins.name: foundry-core
plugins.description: Core delivery discipline: evidence-report, proof-of-work, full-output-enforcement. Wanted on ~every project.

plugins.name: turn-reduction
plugins.description: Fewer wasted turns: capability-preflight, output-lint, standing-authorization.

plugins.name: data-wrangler
plugins.description: Data movement and matching: identity-resolution skill plus the data-pipeline-owner agent.

plugins.name: verification-kit
plugins.description: Verification helpers: fact-currency-check plus the pre-delivery-verifier agent.

plugins.name: consistency-checker
plugins.description: Spec-vs-artifact consistency: spec-artifact-diff plus the cross-document-checker agent.

plugins.name: deploy-ops
plugins.description: Deploy loop discipline: deploy-verify-fix and cloudflare-pages-migration plus the deploy-loop-owner agent.

plugins.name: decks
plugins.description: Build and critique slide decks: scaffolding, charts, HTML diagrams, PPTX export, layout and sales-lens review.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Frontend visual design judgment: design taste, image taste, mobile app screens, minimalist UI, redesigns, the Scrollback SB-01 design system, and UI-polish review guidance.

plugins.name: workbench
plugins.description: Graham's general-purpose working skills: project setup and scaffolding, phased/sweep/rulings/experiment harnesses, handoffs, retros, source intake, knowledge bases, skill discovery, systems design.

plugins.name: graham-voice
plugins.description: Graham's personal writing voice, as its own single-skill install unit. Split out of workbench so it can be installed alone.
